text: You've got to want it as bad as you want to breathe.
And if you want it that bad,
if you're willing to give it that much, you'll get a big piece of what you want.
Anything you want can happen and become a reality.
I believe that sincerely, and I'll die on that thought, okay?
And I say that not from something I read, that's from something I lived, okay?
